Superpowers._caveat: DIFFERENT SHAPE, so read the result carefully. Superpowers is process/methodology guidance (TDD loop, systematic debugging, verification-before-completion); the completeness cases score whether a built artifact embeds domain best practices. A low score here is evidence about fit to THIS measure, not about the project — say so in any published number.
